inspection: Official versioned listing and linear-C3 provenance page read through the web tool. Direct HTTP byte downloads returned 403; this is a selected numerical transcription, not an original HTML archive.
uncertainty_note: Listed uncertainties are estimated 95% confidence limits, not one standard deviation. Do not assume independent species or independent provenance contributors.

correlation.source: Top correlated species on the C3 provenance page, reported as 22.8 percent. This rounded correlation and rounded uncertainties do not replace the full covariance matrix.

provenance.interpretation: Network evaluation with substantial high-level theoretical ancestry, not a new direct calorimetric measurement. Karton2009 is an input to ATcT and must not be counted again as independent validation of this output.

reaction_definition: 3 C(g) -> linear ground-state C3(g); atomization is the reverse reaction. This is not the single-fragment dissociation C3 -> C2 + C.
isomer_scope: Cyclic singlet and cyclic triplet are distinct entries, not alternative values for linear ground-state C3. Their presence does not alone specify a high-temperature internal partition sum.
